Maria CS: Heads up — prepping QBR for Helios, their embedding usage spiked last week and credits are at ~82%. We need a mitigation + renewal-safe ask.
Ajay Sales: saw that, flagged in CRM and told the AE. Do we have a short spend forecast to bring to the QBR?
Noah FinOps: pulling numbers now. Quick preview: if recent rate holds, monthly burn goes from 1.2B -> ~1.8B tokens (commit is 1.5B).
Sophie Onboard: FYI: onboarding batch jobs kicked off 2026-03-12, they flipped to full-embed rollout yesterday which explains the jump.
Maria CS: Ask: can we produce a one-slide summary (current usage, 30/60/90 forecast, top 3 mitigations, clear renewal ask) by Tue AM?
Ken Platform: We can suggest a config change that should help immediately: lower batch_size to 8 and enable KV prefix caching for embed-heavy calls. Expect ~30-40% token reduction on write-heavy patterns.
Noah FinOps: For the slide, please include three finance options: 1) one-time credits top-up (30d), 2) conservative throttle & rate-limits, 3) upsell to higher commit. I'll add projected $ impact.
Sophie Onboard: I can demo an embed-only read path for their most frequent flows (cuts duplicate writes). Can record a 30s gif.
Ajay Sales: AE said client is sensitive to surprise bills but open to a short credits bridge if we show rollback plan.
Maria CS: Also need operational ask: enable a budget alert at 70% and an escalation to CS PM when threshold hit.
alertbot: Alert rule created: channel=#cs-ops, threshold=70%, scope=helios-prod, notify=@Maria CS,@Ajay Sales.
Noah FinOps: Adding forecast numbers for the slide: MTD tokens=1.2B, projected 30d=1.8B, commit=1.5B. Will attach a small table.
Maria CS: Cool. Who's drafting the slide bullets? Keep language customer-facing and concise: problem, impact, options, recommended ask, next steps.
Ken Platform: Drafting bullets now, dropping below.
Ken Platform: ```
Mitigation options:
- Short-term (0-48h): throttle embeddings to 60% for non-critical endpoints; set budget alert to 70%
- Mid-term (48h-2w): enable KV prefix caching + reduce batch_size to 8; prune duplicate writes
- Long-term (2w+): quantify model selection / quantization + scheduled off-peak processing for heavy jobs
```
Sophie Onboard: +1. I'll attach the demo gif and a short runbook snippet for the AE.
Ajay Sales: AE update: client would accept a 30-day credit advance if we provide a rollback plan and a follow-up cadence.
Maria CS: Great — meeting to finalize slides Tue 09:00 PT. Noah you cover cost/forecast, I’ll handle renewal ask, Sophie demos enablement, Ken provides ops notes.
Noah FinOps: Confirmed.
Ajay Sales: Confirmed.
Sophie Onboard: Confirmed.
Ken Platform: Booked.
Maria CS: Thanks all — looping in @legal if we finalize credit terms. :thumbsup:
